text:
Which action will not magnetise a rod?
A
placing a copper rod inside a coil carrying a direct current
B
stroking a steel rod with a permanent magnet
C
hammering a steel rod aligned with the Earth’s magnetic field
D
placing a soft-iron rod close to a permanent magnet

options.label: A
options.text: placing a copper rod inside a coil carrying a direct current

options.label: B
options.text: stroking a steel rod with a permanent magnet

options.label: C
options.text: hammering a steel rod aligned with the Earth’s magnetic field

options.label: D
options.text: placing a soft-iron rod close to a permanent magnet
